        Careers

        anthony@oxy.co2026-06-17T21:57:45-07:00

        Join PayZen

        PayZen's vision is to make care accessible and affordable for every patient.

        At the crossroads of FinTech and healthcare, PayZen is transforming one of the industry’s toughest challenges: patient financing. Our AI-powered platform offers zero-interest payment plans that ease financial stress for patients while boosting cash flow for providers. By rethinking how care is funded, we’re creating meaningful change for patients and healthcare systems alike.

        Our mission is simple yet powerful— be the affordability layer that removes the financial and administrative friction for health systems and patients.

        Why Join PayZen?

        Impact * Growth * Collaboration

        When you join PayZen, you become part of a company that’s reshaping an industry. We offer more than competitive compensation and benefits—we offer career-defining opportunities.

        Make an Impact

        Be part of a mission-driven company transforming healthcare and solving real-world problems at scale. At PayZen, you’ll directly contribute to meaningful change in the industry while building solutions that matter.

        Grow Your Career

        We invest in your growth through bi-annual feedback, compensation reviews, and career planning. You’ll take ownership of high-impact projects and develop skills that drive career-defining experiences. At PayZen, compensation is performance-driven—we measure impact to distribute reward.

        Thrive in a Dynamic Culture

        Collaboration and transparency are at the heart of our culture. From open Q&A at company-wide All Hands meetings to engagement surveys that shape how we work, every voice matters. We know that diverse thinking leads to extraordinary outcomes.

        Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

        PayZen is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

        Life at PayZen

        Headquarters

        San Francisco (Near Oracle Park) and Tel Aviv.

        Hybrid Schedule

        In-office Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday, remote Wednesday and Friday.

        Competitive Benefits

        PayZen offers US-based roles discretionary time-off, 16 weeks of parental leave, and fully paid healthcare plans for employees.

        Connection

        Team meals, collaborative spaces, and global events that foster strong relationships.

        At PayZen, we believe in the power of innovation and empathy to transform healthcare payments.

        If you’re ready to grow, make an impact, and work in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment, explore our open roles and apply today.
